title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Dickinson College
description: When the Waidner-Spahr Library sessions stretch late, Dickinsonians rely on a mix of on-campus hubs and local Carlisle staples. From the classic 'Hotchee' dog to 24-hour convenience runs, these spots define the after-hours experience in this historic college town.

cards.title: Union Station
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Campus Hub
cards.notes: Located in the Holland Union Building, this is the primary spot for late-night burgers and specialty sandwiches using meal plan points.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus dining option for students seeking hot food and snacks until late in the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Union Station is located in the upper level of the Holland Union Building and is conveniently open from breakfast until late at night.
cards.source_title: Union Station Hours & Menu - Carlisle - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM most weeknights during the academic semester.

cards.title: The Juice Bar at Underground
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Smoothies & Sushi
cards.notes: Found in the Underground Student Lounge, it offers a healthier late-night alternative with smoothies and fresh sushi.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge cafe providing organic coffee, fresh juices, and sushi for late-night study breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Underground Student Lounge featuring The Juice Bar... serves organically grown fair-trade coffees, fruit and vegetable juice, made-to-order smoothies, teas and sushi.
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM on weeknights.

cards.title: Devil's Den
cards.subtitle: Campus Convenience Store
cards.notes: The go-to for dorm room essentials, snacks, and groceries located in the lower level of the HUB.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience store stocked with snacks, produce, and pantry staples for late-night needs.
cards.evidence_claim: Devils Den has snacks and groceries, including fresh produce, fresh meats, cheeses, fresh dairy, a frozen aisle, and a pantry aisle.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM daily during the school year.

cards.title: Carlisle Diner
cards.subtitle: Classic 24/7 Diner
cards.notes: A local staple for all-day breakfast and late-night comfort food, popular for post-event gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A traditional family diner offering late-night dining and breakfast favorites 24 hours a day.
cards.evidence_claim: Late night dining and all day breakfast offerings make us your one-stop shop for the best food in Carlisle!

cards.title: Hamilton Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Home of the Hotchee Dog
cards.notes: Famous for its 'Hotchee' dogs, this historic spot is a must-visit for students exploring downtown Carlisle.
cards.short_summary: A Greek-owned local favorite since the 1920s, known for its signature hot dogs and Greek salads.
cards.evidence_claim: Greek owned local favorite since 1920s and award winner for best hot dogs; try their famous 'hotchee' dog.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM or 9:30 PM; a classic 'early' late-night stop.

cards.title: Sheetz on Harrisburg Pike
cards.subtitle: 24/7 MTO Run
cards.notes: The essential 24-hour run for 'Made-To-Order' food, from appetizer samplers to breakfast burritos.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience destination for students with cars or using delivery for late-night MTO snacks.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: The 24-Hour Grand Slam
cards.notes: A reliable off-campus destination for late-night breakfast and burgers when campus options are closed.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner serving breakfast, burgers, and milkshakes at any hour of the night.
cards.evidence_claim: From 24 hour breakfast in Carlisle to late night food in Carlisle, we serve pancakes, Grand Slams, burgers, and breakfast sandwiches 24/7.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Cravings
cards.notes: Located on East High Street, this is a frequent stop for quick, late-night tacos and burritos.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food choice for students seeking late-night meals near the downtown area.
cards.evidence_claim: Find Taco Bell for dinner near you at 401 East High Street in Carlisle, PA... Open til 1:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® Dinner Near Me in Carlisle, PA
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically open until 1:00 AM or later.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Golden Arches
cards.notes: A convenient stop on East High Street for late-night fries and burgers, often accessible via drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A standard late-night fast food option for students located just east of the main campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's at 608 E High, Carlisle, PA... Open now [late night].
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open late; hours vary by day.

cards.title: Miseno II Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Pizza Slices
cards.notes: Located on West High Street, it's a prime spot for a quick slice of pizza or an Italian sub.
cards.short_summary: A local pizzeria offering slices and Italian favorites within walking distance of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Miseno II Pizzeria & Italian - Carlisle, PA - 598 W High St - Hours, Menu, Order.
cards.source_title: Best Pizza by the slice in Carlisle, PA | Miseno Pizza and Ristorante
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:30 PM or 10:00 PM; a popular evening dinner-to-late-night transition spot.
